sources.snippet: OmniVoice → ONNX ONNX conversion of Prince-1/OmniVoice — a zero-shot text-to-speech model supporting 600+ languages — via Olive and onnxruntime-genai ModelBuilder. OmniVoice is not a vision-language model. It is a TTS model: a Qwen3-0.6B backbone driving an 8-codebook audio codec (Higgs Audio V2 Tokenizer) through a 32-step non-autoregressive unmasking loop.
